name: Shizuoka (Japan)
description: A medium-blue field charged at the centre with the Shizuoka city emblem in white: the silhouette of Mount Fuji above a curling wave.
history: The emblem dates from the 2003 merger of Shizuoka and Shimizu; the city became a government-designated city in 2005.

features.role: Shizuoka city emblem — Mount Fuji over a curling wave
features.symbolism: Mount Fuji and Suruga Bay, the city's defining landscape
